reference:
The Argentine National Anthem was adopted on May 11, 1813, as stated in the paragraph: "It has been called 'Himno Nacional Argentino' since it was published with that name in 1847. Its lyrics were written by the Buenos Aires-born politician Vicente López y Planes and the music was composed by the Spanish musician Blas Parera. The work was adopted as the sole official song on May 11, 1813, three years after the May Revolution; May 11 is therefore Anthem Day in Argentina."

FINDING: The Argentine National Anthem was adopted in 1813.
